# Security Policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are maintained on the repository's current default branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities, credentials, tokens, private data, or exploit details
in a public issue.

Report them through a private [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/solar-ai-dev/mcp-work-agent/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected version or commit, reproduction steps, expected impact, and any proposed
mitigation. The maintainers will acknowledge the report and coordinate remediation and disclosure
through that advisory.
